title: fix(ui): keep floating surfaces consistent with their theme
body:
## Summary

Menus, hovercards, Inbox and Sharing use the existing overlay borders and shadows. Sharing labels use muted text and a plain separator.

## Visual comparison

Before: main `f8a97fe87ce21a95b08ace2343c302b75c696962`. After: this PR at `a4b2aabf0d0a39bfdfa0edae5a50ec5cd4fd7f16`. Both use the actual source UI with identical synthetic Gateway data, Claw theme, viewport, scale and framing.

![Sharing in dark mode](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/75dce6e9-7483-4e9b-8d9f-a6ebdae3f898)

![Sharing in light mode](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/383f524e-ba7a-4e9c-a8a3-7f9e9175c235)

<details>
<summary>Hovercard and Inbox</summary>

![Hovercard in dark mode](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2c8ad9d6-9e8b-42c1-a17a-3986e2753072)

![Inbox in dark mode](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/403061d8-888e-4a2c-a93b-d7b5e5b45259)

![Inbox in light mode](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ceb2e0d9-4a31-4acf-a699-8dac8385ae19)

</details>

<details>
<summary>Final mobile Inbox</summary>

![Mobile Inbox in dark mode](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/46272896-8036-4400-8b22-4417053730d8)

![Mobile Inbox in light mode](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/544d3695-40a8-411a-b17a-38eabe1319d9)

</details>

## Validation

- Existing Inbox layout tests: 12 passed.
- Existing mobile Inbox E2E scenarios: 2 passed, covering navigation, local actions, sheet layout and closing controls.
- Updated source captures cover Sharing, hovercard and Inbox in light and dark modes.
- Independent source review completed with no actionable findings. Hovercard and mobile-menu declarations follow their current stylesheet owners.

Browser evidence uses synthetic Gateway data and does not exercise a live model.
